sections.text: Chelsea beat Manchester City 1-0 to go top of the Women's Super League. Chelsea manager Sonia Bompastor made a risky first-half substitution, removing Kadeisha Buchanan after 12 minutes for Veerle Buurman. sections.heading: Why it matters
